name: The AIRecruiter.co Index
description: The talent-market research Index: sourced point-in-time statistics and long-run trackers on how the world hires. Every figure carries a confidence label and links to its primary source.
citation: The AIRecruiter.co Index. AIRecruiter.co, accessed [date accessed]. https://airecruiter.co/data
licenseNote: Free to cite and reuse with attribution to AIRecruiter.co and a link to the cited figure.

confidenceTiers.reported: Consistently reported by a credible publisher.
confidenceTiers.modeled: A market estimate or projection, not a measured figure.
